sql.limitation: row counts, not full row digest, verified for SQL

mongo.method: mongodump archive gzip; mongorestore nsFrom fraud.* to isolated namespace

hdfs.method: Parquet snapshot excluding absolute FileSink logs; separately verified with verify.py --base
hdfs.limitations: does not restore streaming checkpoints or trained models

global_limitations: same host and same service processes
no off-host disaster recovery or measured RPO/RTO
test databases retained separately, no existing data removed
archives remain local, not encrypted backups or final delivery artifacts
